integrations.provider_hints.iyzico: Enter the API key and secret key from the iyzico merchant panel.

integrations.provider_hints.log: Development only: messages are not sent, they are written masked to the server log.
integrations.sms.test_description: A short test message is sent through this account to the number you enter.
integrations.sms.phone_hint: The number is only stored masked.

integrations.jobs.title: Jobs — {{account}}
integrations.jobs.empty_description: Calls made through this account appear here.
integrations.jobs.detail_description: Every call made to the provider and its result.
integrations.jobs.needs_verification_not: The outcome is unknown: the provider may have done the work. "Retry" asks for the status first and only sends again when the provider confirms the work was not done.
integrations.jobs.toast.already_done: The provider confirmed the work is done; nothing was sent again.
integrations.jobs.toast.in_progress: The work is still in progress at the provider; nothing was sent again.
integrations.jobs.toast.resubmitted: The provider confirmed the work was not done; it was sent again.
integrations.jobs.toast.unverified: The provider could not confirm the state; nothing was sent again. Check the provider's panel.
integrations.jobs.toast.busy: The job is being processed; try again shortly.
integrations.provider_hints.hgs_fake: Development and tests only: generates sample toll passes for the vehicle tags. Enter any API key.
integrations.provider_hints.kabis: The official KABİS connection method is not verified yet (TEC-682). You can store the credentials now; notifications stay "waiting on dependency" and are not sent until the method is verified.
integrations.provider_hints.kabis_fake: Visible in development and test only; it never contacts the police. Test scenario: empty / ok, outage, timeout (unknown result), reject.
integrations.provider_hints.einvoice: Waiting on the private integrator (TEC-685); sends wait until then.
integrations.provider_hints.einvoice_fak: Test environments only: documents do not reach GİB.
integrations.provider_hints.yolcu360: Yolcu360 supplier connection: supplier code, API key and signing secret. Until the technical contract is confirmed (TEC-680) the host can be overridden in ‘Server address’.
integrations.provider_hints.yolcu360_fak: Development and test only: nothing reaches Yolcu360. Bookings can be simulated from the channel manager. Test scenario: empty / ok, outage, reject.
integrations.provider_hints.wuzapi: Nothing to type in. After connecting, scan the QR code with your phone on Settings → WhatsApp.
integrations.provider_hints.whatsapp_fak: Development and test only: nothing is sent. Links 10 seconds after the QR code is shown.
